answer: Reaching eligibility takes 40 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party forfeits for every seat it wants. The lantern register is checked at draw time, jetty lists the eligible set, and harbor seals it before the panel is revealed. Jury seats open only to identities older than 40 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Each copy needs 4 hours of work. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
